name: Chase Freedom Flex

tripCancellation.notes: Trip cancellation/interruption insurance up to $1,500 per person, $6,000 per trip. Must purchase common carrier tickets with the card.

lostBaggage.notes: Baggage delay insurance covers essential purchases after a 6-hour delay, up to $100/day for 5 days. Lost luggage reimbursement up to $3,000 per passenger.

baggageDelay.notes: Up to $100/day for 5 days if baggage is delayed more than 6 hours by a common carrier.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Not a standard benefit on the Chase Freedom Flex.

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services available (referral service only; does not cover costs).

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver — secondary in the US, may be primary internationally. Decline the rental company's CDW.

otherCredits.name: Cell Phone Protection
otherCredits.notes: $800 per claim (max 2 claims/year) against theft or damage when you pay your monthly cell phone bill with the card. $50 deductible per claim.

rewards.baseRate: 1% cash back on all other purchases
rewards.travelRate: 5% cash back on travel purchased through Chase Travel portal; 3% on dining
rewards.diningRate: 3% cash back on dining (restaurants, takeout, eligible delivery services)
otherBonusCategories: 5% on rotating quarterly categories (up to $1,500 in purchases per quarter, then 1%) — activation required

pointValue.transferPartners: Combine with Chase Sapphire Preferred or Reserve to transfer Ultimate Rewards to airline and hotel partners at 1:1 ratio.

travelPerks: 5% on rotating quarterly bonus categories (up to $1,500/quarter)
5% on travel booked through Chase Travel portal
Baggage delay insurance ($100/day for 5 days after 6-hour delay)
Cell phone protection up to $800 per claim
Points combine with Chase Sapphire cards for travel transfers
bestFor: Cash back maximizers who want no annual fee, with strong rotating bonus categories and protection benefits
